_note: Starting content for new games (edit it in the question builder). Election details are for the Nov. 3, 2026 NC general election, taken from ncsbe.gov; the host can change them in Host setup for a later election. Voting content is only about how to prepare to vote, never who to vote for.

questions.prompt: Before Election Day, what should you check first?
options: My voter registration and address
Which momo place is open late
A friend's post about the election
What time polls close in another state
questions.trail_fact: In North Carolina, look yourself up with the Voter Search on ncsbe.gov. Registered somewhere else? vote.gov has every state's info.

questions.prompt: What is Mount Everest called in Nepali?
options: Sagarmatha
Annapurna
Kanchenjunga
Lhotse
questions.trail_fact: Sagarmatha is often translated as "forehead of the sky." At 8,849 m (29,032 ft), it's the highest mountain on Earth, on the border of Nepal and Tibet.

questions.prompt: Who can register to vote in North Carolina?
options: U.S. citizens who'll be 18 by Election Day and have lived in the county 30 days
Anyone who lives in North Carolina
Only people born in North Carolina
Only people with an NC driver's license
questions.reveal_title: Citizen, 18, and 30 days in the county
questions.trail_fact: You can't be serving a felony sentence (including probation or parole). 16- and 17-year-olds can preregister and are registered automatically at 18. Details on ncsbe.gov.

questions.prompt: Your team wants to vote early in Greensboro. Which source do you trust for sites and hours?
options: The Early Voting Site Search on ncsbe.gov
A flyer from last year's election
A post shared on social media
questions.trail_fact: Early voting sites and hours can change every election. Check ncsbe.gov or your county board of elections (Guilford County for Greensboro).

questions.prompt: Dashain, Nepal's biggest festival, lasts how many days?
options: 3 days
7 days
15 days
30 days
questions.trail_fact: Families gather for Dashain, and elders give tika and blessings. It celebrates good winning over evil.

questions.prompt: You missed the voter registration deadline. Can you still register in North Carolina?
options: Yes, at an early voting site in my county, during early voting
Yes, at any polling place on Election Day
No, I have to wait for the next election
Only by mailing in a form
questions.trail_fact: Bring proof of where you live, like a bill, bank statement or paycheck. Students can show a college document with their name and address, such as a housing portal screenshot. It isn't available on Election Day for most voters.

questions.prompt: During Tihar, the festival of lights, which animals get their own day of honour?
options: Crows, dogs and cows
Cats, horses and goats
Elephants and tigers
Fish and parrots
questions.trail_fact: Tihar lasts five days. It honours crows, dogs, cows and oxen, and ends with Bhai Tika, when sisters bless their brothers.

questions.prompt: You get to the polls in North Carolina without an acceptable photo ID. What happens?
options: I can still vote by filling out an ID Exception Form
I'm sent home and can't vote
I have to pay a fee to vote
I can only vote in the next election
questions.trail_fact: Every voter can vote with or without photo ID. Accepted IDs include an NC driver's license, a U.S. passport and approved college IDs. Check the list on ncsbe.gov.

questions.prompt: What makes Nepal's national flag different from every other country's?
options: It isn't a rectangle
It's purple
It's round
It has no colours
questions.trail_fact: Nepal's flag is two crimson pennants with a blue border, showing the moon and the sun. It's the only national flag that isn't a rectangle.

questions.prompt: A text from an unknown number says your polling place has moved. What do you trust?
options: The Polling Place Search on ncsbe.gov
Reply to the text and ask for the new address
Go to last year's polling place anyway
questions.trail_fact: If something sounds off, look it up on an official site or call your county board of elections. Never trust a message just because it sounds urgent.

questions.prompt: On Election Day in North Carolina, where do you vote?
options: At my assigned polling place
At any early voting site in the state
At any polling place in my county
Online
questions.trail_fact: During early voting you can go to any early voting site in your county. On Election Day you vote at your own polling place. Look it up on ncsbe.gov.

questions.prompt: Which ring-shaped sweet rice bread is a favourite at Tihar and Dashain?
options: Sel roti
Dal bhat
Gundruk
Chatamari
questions.trail_fact: Sel roti is made from rice flour batter, sugar and ghee, fried in a ring. Families make it to share with neighbours and relatives at festival time.

questions.prompt: One day left before the election. Explain your team's full plan: when you'll vote, how you'll get there, what you need to bring, and where you'll check for updates. Then give your backup plan.
